items.text: Use for Planning and Use for Costing are real check boxes, defined the same way on both the BOM (tibom3100m000) and the routing (tirou4100m000): if selected, that record is the one LN actually uses for planning, or for costing, respectively. Only one BOM per item and site can be used for planning; only one BOM per product can be used for costing — and the same one-at-a-time rule applies to routings used for costing. Approve Revision is a real Actions-menu command that records Approved By and Approved On on the revision; the help does not state that approval is a hard precondition for using the BOM elsewhere in the flow, so that stronger reading remains unconfirmed.

blocks.text: Updated 2026-08-13 — the underlying mechanism is now documented, from session help filed after this review was first written. Material to Issue for Production Orders (ticst0101m100) maintains material quantities that must move from the warehouse to the production center. The Initiate action relates to a distinct session, Initiate Inventory Issue (tisfc0207m000), which unblocks the material's warehouse order line so warehouse staff can begin the outbound procedure — generate advice, pick, ship to the job shop. Two check boxes decide how much of that is automatic:

tokens.v: — if selected, the warehouse order line unblocks automatically on production-order release, and
never needs to be run by hand.

items.text: Direct Initiate Inventory Issue — if selected, the warehouse order line unblocks automatically on production-order release, and tisfc0207m000 never needs to be run by hand.

items.text: Direct Process Warehouse Order Line — if selected, the entire outbound procedure runs automatically once the line is unblocked; if cleared, the Activities by Warehousing Order (whinh2104m000) settings decide which of those outbound steps are automatic versus manual.
